title: Construction Period and Extension Allowances (Construction Loans)
content:
Every Construction Loans product runs for a fixed construction period from closing to the construction end date, and may be extended a limited number of times by a fixed number of months. The schedule also fixes how far ahead of the end date an extension request must be registered, and after how long without progress a project is treated as stalled.

| Product | Construction period (months from closing to the construction end date) | Most extensions | Months added by one extension | Lead time: calendar days before the construction end date by which an extension request must be registered | Days without draw or inspection progress before referral as stalled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 12 | 1 | 3 | 30 | 90 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 12 | 2 | 3 | 30 | 90 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 12 | 2 | 3 | 30 | 90 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 12 | 1 | 3 | 30 | 90 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 9 | 1 | 3 | 30 | 90 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 12 | 2 | 3 | 45 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Construction period** — Months from closing to the construction end date.
- **Maximum extensions** — Most extensions of the construction period.
- **Extension length** — Months added by one extension.
- **Extension request lead time** — Calendar days before the construction end date by which an extension request must be registered.
- **Stalled project period** — Calendar days without a draw or inspection progress after which the project is referred to a loan officer as stalled.

## Longest construction period with every extension taken

Read from the schedule alone, the construction period plus the most extensions at their fixed length comes to:

| Product | Construction period | Extensions available, each 3 months | Longest period in all |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 12 months | 1 | 15 months |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 12 months | 2 | 18 months |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 12 months | 2 | 18 months |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 12 months | 1 | 15 months |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 9 months | 1 | 12 months |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 12 months | 2 | 18 months |

The Livestock Facility Construction Loan differs from the rest in two figures: its extension request lead time is 45 calendar days rather than 30, and its stalled project period is 60 calendar days rather than 90.
